description: Get one Request by request_id (id, status, assignee, owner). Does not include the request body. Submit, list, acknowledge, and transitions stay on request. Prefer this over request action get. Read-only: does not advance the unread cursor. REST: GET /v1/requests/{id}. Idempotent.

request_id.description: Request id, from list_requests, space_state or a message's request_id.
